title: Learning Implicit Solves for Dynamic Simulations
abstract: arXiv:2611.05439v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: High-fidelity simulation of dynamical systems is central to scientific discovery and engineering design, yet remains computationally demanding. Here we introduce the Implicit Neural Operator Solver (INOS), which learns the implicit solve and encodes a time integrator. INOS pretrains a neural operator from static equilibrium solutions and reuses it within Newmark-$\beta$ integration. At each time increment, the integrator forms an effective equilibrium problem, the pretrained neural operator infers the next-step solution field, and the Newmark relations advance the dynamic state. Numerical examples in linear and nonlinear elastodynamics demonstrate accurate full-field predictions without dynamic trajectory supervision. Comparative results show that INOS, evaluated zero-shot, achieves higher predictive accuracy than neural solver baselines trained on dynamic simulations. translated_title: 学习动力学仿真中的隐式求解
translated_abstract: 动力学系统的高保真仿真是科学发现与工程设计的核心，但其计算成本依然高昂。本文提出隐式神经算子求解器（INOS），它学习隐式求解过程并编码时间积分器。INOS从静态平衡解中预训练一个神经算子，并将其复用于Newmark-β积分中。在每个时间增量步，积分器构造一个有效平衡问题，预训练的神经算子推断下一步的解场，再由Newmark关系推进动力学状态。线性和非线性弹性动力学的数值算例表明，该方法在无需动力学轨迹监督的情况下即可实现精确的全场预测。对比结果显示，经零样本评估的INOS在预测精度上优于在动力学仿真上训练的神经求解器基线。此外，INOS在非线性仿真中实现了超过4600倍的加速。
tldr: 提出隐式神经算子求解器INOS，仅从静态平衡解预训练神经算子并嵌入Newmark-β时间积分，无需动力学轨迹监督即可零样本实现高精度动力学仿真，并在非线性仿真中获得超过4600倍加速。
en_tdlr: INOS pretrains a neural operator on static equilibrium solutions and reuses it within Newmark-β integration, achieving zero-shot accurate dynamic simulations without trajectory supervision and delivering over 4,600× speedup in nonlinear simulations.
